title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
🌱
 **We’re Hiring: Sports Anchor \& Social Media Content Creator – 7\-Day Tournament Role** 




  





 We’re looking for a
 **Sports Anchor \& Social Media Content Creator** 
 for a 7\-day sports tournament — the
 **Indian Pickleball League (IPBL)** 
 .
 



  





 We’re looking for someone confident, creative, energetic, and genuinely passionate about sports, who can create engaging content and bring the tournament experience to life on social media.
 



  





 🎯 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Create engaging, real\-time content for social media platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, etc.
* Ideate and produce reels, short\-form videos, stories, and posts around the tournament, players, teams, and matches.
* Stay updated with sports trends and identify opportunities for engaging content.
* Write witty, informative, and attention\-grabbing captions and scripts.
* Conduct quick interviews with players, teams, and other stakeholders.
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes moments and highlight interesting stories from the tournament.
* Be comfortable being on camera and engaging with players, audiences, and the sports community.
* Bring energy and creativity to the tournament experience through content.



  





 🧩 Requirements:
 


* Prior experience in sports content creation, anchoring, journalism, or social media.
* Strong interest and understanding of sports.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Comfortable being both behind and in front of the camera.
* Ability to create engaging, relatable, and platform\-friendly content.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, on\-ground tournament environment.
* Willingness to learn about pickleball and the tournament quickly.



  





 ✨ Good to Have:
 


* Background in journalism, media, sports communication, or content creation.
* Experience working with a sports organisation, broadcast channel, digital media platform, or sports tournament.
* Experience creating reels, interviews, or other short\-form sports content.

 Subject line: \[Your Name \| Application for Sports Anchor \& Social Media Content Creator]

1. *What makes you a good fit for this role?*
2. Your resume
3. Your portfolio/work samples



 Email to:
 



 aanchal.kheria@buffalosoldiers.in
 



 hr@buffalosoldiers.in
 



  





  





 🚀

 Buffalo Soldiers is a growth\-stage start\-up — an integrated creative agency with a digital heart.
 



 We help companies build brands through layered storytelling: textual, visual, and video\-based.
 



 We’re a team of entrepreneurs and artists — many of us are sports fans who are
 *unusually fanatic* 
 about the games we love.
 



 Please read our culture \& values before applying:
 



 👉 https://buffalosoldiersdigital.com/careers/
 



 🎥 Also, watch our culture video here:
 *Culture at BS* 




 At Buffalo Soldiers, we:
 


* Take our business seriously, but not ourselves
* Believe intelligence, attitude, and energy often trump experience

title: Business Marketing
description:

 :

 In this role, you will spearhead developing and implementing innovative marketing strategies that resonate with our target audience, effectively communicating the unique value of HCL Tech's IT Infrastructure unit. You are responsible for providing strong leadership and establishing a high\-performing, diverse and empowered team. The role also emphasizes the importance of partnerships, consistently striving to find win\-win solutions while fostering trust with all stakeholders to create a collaborative and transparent environment.
 



 As the Marketing Lead, you will stay abreast of industry trends, competitor activities, and market conditions to inform your strategies. Your insights will guide the team in adapting to changes and seizing new opportunities for growth.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Leadership:** 
 Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing strategy that supports the growth and positioning of one of the business units in IT Infrastructure division.
 



**Brand Development:** 
 Elevate HCL Tech's brand presence by executing initiatives that enhance visibility and establish the company as a thought leader in all the services related to IT Infrastructure services.

 Manage end\-to\-end content creation to deliver compelling messages that resonate with target audiences and highlight the division's value proposition.

 Lead performance marketing efforts to optimize campaigns, analyze results and ensure effective allocation of marketing resources for maximum ROI.

 : Foster strong partnerships with sales, practice and delivery teams to ensure cohesive execution of marketing initiatives that drive business results.

title: Chief of Staff – CEO Office | Business Strategy
description:
**Job Description:** 




 The Chief of Staff – CEO Office (CPaaS Business) will work directly with the CEO to drive strategic growth, operating performance, and execution across the company's CPaaS business.
 



 This individual will serve as the CEO's execution partner for CPaaS — bridging business strategy, revenue performance, product priorities, enterprise sales, partnerships, technology, operations, and financial performance.
 



 This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role suited to an exceptionally analytical and commercially minded professional who can move seamlessly between strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.
 



**Chief of Staff – CEO Office \| Business Strategy** 




 Experience: 2–5 years
 



 Education: MBA/PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad / IIM Bangalore / IIM Calcutta preferred
 



 Location: Noida
 



 Reporting to: CEO
 



 Function: CEO Office / Strategy \& Business Operations
 



 Industry: CPaaS / Telecom / SaaS / Technology
 



**Role Purpose:** 




 The Chief of Staff – CEO Office, CPaaS Business will work directly with the CEO to drive the strategic growth, operating performance and execution of the company's CPaaS business.
 



 The individual will act as the CEO's execution partner for CPaaS, bringing together business strategy, revenue performance, product priorities, enterprise sales, partnerships, technology, operations and financial performance.
 



 This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role suited to an exceptionally analytical, commercially oriented professional who can move seamlessly between strategic thinking and execution.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. CEO Office \& Strategic Priorities
 


* Work directly with the CEO on CPaaS business priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Convert CEO objectives into clearly defined action plans, owners, milestones and timelines.
* Prepare CEO\-level business reviews, strategic presentations and decision papers.
* Identify critical business issues and independently drive them towards resolution.
* Act as a central point of coordination between the CEO and functional leaders.



 2\. CPaaS Business Growth
 


* Own the strategic agenda for CPaaS growth across SMS, OTP, WhatsApp Business API, RCS, Voice and other communication APIs.
* Track revenue, gross margin, volumes, customer acquisition, retention, and contribution by product/channel.
* Identify new revenue opportunities, customer segments, use cases and geographies.
* Develop business cases for new CPaaS products, partnerships, and commercial opportunities.
* Monitor competitive positioning, pricing and market developments.



 3\. Revenue \& Commercial Strategy
 


* Work closely with Sales and Business Development to build the CPaaS growth plan.
* Track pipeline, conversion, average revenue per customer, churn and revenue concentration.
* Analyse customer profitability and product/channel economics.
* Support pricing strategy and commercial negotiations for key accounts.
* Develop dashboards for daily/weekly/monthly business performance.



 4\. Business Analytics \& MIS
 


* Build a strong CPaaS Business MIS / CEO Dashboard.
* Track key metrics such as:
* Revenue
* Message volumes
* Gross margin
* EBITDA contribution
* Customer acquisition
* Active customers
* Enterprise pipeline
* Conversion rate
* Churn
* ARPU
* DSO/collections
* Delivery rate
* API uptime
* Product\-wise/channel\-wise performance
* Convert data into clear insights and recommendations for the CEO.



 5\. Cross\-functional Execution
 


* Work across Product, Technology, Sales, Finance, Operations, Customer Success and Compliance.
* Ensure strategic projects are delivered on time.
* Establish weekly/monthly operating rhythms.
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to the CEO.
* Follow through until closure rather than merely coordinating.



 6\. Market \& Competitive Intelligence
 


* Continuously track competitors, pricing, product launches and partnerships.
* Study developments across CPaaS, conversational commerce, RCS, WhatsApp, AI communications and network APIs.
* Prepare quarterly strategic reviews for the CEO.
* Identify potential partnerships, acquisitions and strategic opportunities.



 7\. Financial \& Business Planning
 


* Support annual operating plans and CPaaS budgets.
* Assist in revenue forecasting and scenario planning.
* Analyse unit economics and profitability.
* Work with Finance to understand business performance and deviations from plan.



 8\. CEO Projects / Special Situations
 


* Take ownership of high\-priority projects assigned by the CEO.
* Prepare business cases and management presentations.
* Support investor/board\-level reporting where required.
* Handle confidential strategic initiatives with maturity and discretion.

title: Performance marketing Manager
description:
**About Times Internet** 




  





 At Times Internet, we create premium digital products that simplify and enhance the lives of millions. As India’s largest digital products company, we have a significant presence across a wide range of categories, including News, Sports, Fintech, and Enterprise solutions.
 



 Our portfolio features market\-leading and iconic brands such as TOI, ET, NBT, Cricbuzz, Times Prime, Times Card, Indiatimes, Whatshot, Abound, Willow TV, Techgig and Times Mobile among many more. Each of these products is crafted to enrich your experiences and bring you closer to your interests and aspirations.
 



 As an equal opportunity employer, Times Internet strongly promotes inclusivity and diversity. We are proud to have achieved overall gender pay parity in 2018, verified by an independent audit conducted by Aon Hewitt.
 



 We are driven by the excitement of new possibilities and are committed to bringing innovative products, ideas, and technologies to help people make the most of every day. Join us and take us to the next level!
 



  





**About the Business Unit (ET Learning)** 




  





 ET is India’s largest and most respected business, markets and personal finance news platform. We inform and actively engage business leaders, investors and entrepreneurs in driving economic growth and opportunity. We bring you the latest, in\-depth coverage of the economy, stock markets, business developments and personal finance changes everyday. ET is India’s No.1 Business News Destination with the highest number of loyal business news readers.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 As a Performance Marketer, you will be the execution backbone of ET Learning's paid growth engine. You will own Meta (Facebook, Instagram, Reels, WhatsApp) campaign planning, execution, and optimization on a day\-to\-day basis—turning creative assets into scalable, high\-ROAS acquisition funnels.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-intensity role for someone who lives inside Ads Manager, obsesses over hook rates and thumb\-stop ratios, and can translate data signals into creative briefs that move the needle. You will work closely with the Creative Strategist, Analytics, Product, and Sales teams to drive subscriber acquisition \& driving growth for our learning business.
 



 If you've scaled paid acquisition for a learning platform, app subscription business, or D2C brand and know what it takes to profitably spend ₹1–3 Cr\+/month on Meta—this role is for you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Meta Campaign Ownership \& Execution
 



 Day\-to\-Day Campaign Management: Plan, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns for multiple product categories (Subscription for ET Prime, Learning Courses across different category \- AI Courses, Money \& Markets, Kids/Parenting, Health).
 



 Budget Stewardship: Manage monthly budgets of ₹1–3 Cr\+ with sharp accountability on CAC, ROAS, and payback period targets.
 



 Algorithm Mastery: Stay ahead of Meta's algorithm shifts, bidding strategies (Advantage\+, ASC, CBO vs. ABO), and audience signal changes to maintain competitive efficiency.
 



 Pixel \& Tracking Hygiene: Ensure flawless pixel/CAPI implementation, event tracking, and attribution accuracy in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.
 



 2\. Creative\-Performance Loop
 



 Data\-to\-Brief Translation: Analyse campaign data to generate actionable creative briefs—identifying winning hooks, formats, CTAs, and audience\-message combinations.
 



 High\-Velocity Testing: Run a structured testing framework: 15–20\+ new creative variants per week across categories, with clear hypotheses and kill criteria.
 



 Creative Fatigue Management: Monitor creative decay, manage ad rotation schedules, and ensure a constant pipeline of fresh, high\-performing assets.
 



 UGC \& Native Content: Champion "UGC\-style," platform\-native creatives that outperform polished brand ads—working with the Creative Strategist to produce testimonial\-led, instructor\-led, and hook\-driven formats.
 



 3\. Funnel Optimization \& Conversion
 



 Landing Page A/B Testing: Collaborate with Product to continuously test landing pages, checkout flows, and trial\-to\-paid conversion levers.
 



 Full\-Funnel Thinking: Own performance from impression to activation—tracking drop\-offs at every stage and driving improvements in CTR, landing page conversion, trial start, and subscription completion.
 



 Cross\-Channel Coordination: Coordinate with organic, email/push, and Inside Sales teams to ensure cohesive messaging and lead handoffs.
 



 4\. Reporting \& Intelligence
 



 Performance Reporting: Build and maintain daily/weekly dashboards tracking spend, CAC, LTV, hook rates, CTR, CPM trends, and cohort\-level payback.
 



 Competitive Benchmarking: Monitor competitor ad libraries, creative trends, and positioning shifts in the EdTech, learning, and subscription space.
 



 Insight Generation: Proactively surface insights from data—why a creative worked, why a cohort churned, what seasonal or behavioural triggers to capitalize on.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  





 Meta Ads Power\-User: Deep, hands\-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager—campaign architecture, audience strategy, bidding, creative testing, and troubleshooting at scale.
 



 Analytical Sharpness: Ability to read dashboards, diagnose funnel leaks, and connect creative/media decisions to revenue outcomes. Comfortable with Excel, GA4, and BI tools.
 



 Creative Intuition: A strong eye for what stops the scroll. You understand consumer psychology—what triggers action in education, self\-improvement, and aspiration\-driven purchases.
 



 Speed \& Rigour: You move fast but with structure. Hypotheses are documented, tests are clean, and learnings are catalogued.
 



 Communication: Ability to clearly articulate performance stories to leadership—what happened, why, and what's next.
 



 Adaptability: Comfortable in fast\-paced environments with shifting priorities. Proactive in adopting new AI tools, automation workflows, and platform features.
 



  





**Experience Requirements** 




 3–5 years in Performance Marketing / Paid Social, with a primary focus on Meta platforms.
 



 Proven Scale: Hands\-on experience managing monthly ad spends of ₹50L–3Cr\+ with demonstrable CAC and ROAS outcomes.
 



 Category Fit: Prior experience in at least one of the following is mandatory: EdTech / Online Learning, App\-based Subscription products, or high\-consideration D2C brands.
 



 Bonus: Experience with subscription/SaaS models (trial\-to\-paid funnels), WhatsApp\-led acquisition, or working with expert/instructor\-led content products.
 



 Tools: Proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics / GA4, AppsFlyer/Branch (preferred), and Excel/Google Sheets for reporting and analysis.

title: Retention Marketing Executive
description:
**Job Title: Retention Marketing Executive** 




**Experience: 2\-4 years** 




**Location: Noida Sec \-16, WTT Building** 




**Job Type: Full\-time** 




  
 



**Company Overview:** 




 GreenHonchos is a fast\-growing eCommerce solutions provider, helping brands scale and succeed in the digital landscape. With a strong presence in India and Dubai, we leverage technology, AI, and data\-driven strategies to drive growth. Our team thrives on creativity, collaboration, and cutting\-edge technology, making GreenHonchos the perfect place for ambitious professionals looking to drive real impact in the eCommerce space.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute customer retention strategies and campaigns to increase customer loyalty, repeat purchases, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).
* Analyze customer data, purchase behavior, and engagement patterns to identify retention opportunities and churn risks.
* Develop customer segments and personas based on customer behavior, preferences, purchase frequency, RFM, and lifecycle stage.
* Plan and manage customer lifecycle campaigns across email, WhatsApp, SMS, push notifications, and other CRM channels.
* Create and optimize email marketing campaigns, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing, automation, and performance tracking.
* Develop and manage loyalty, rewards, referral, win\-back, cross\-sell, upsell, and reactivation campaigns.
* Implement and optimize retargeting campaigns, including dynamic product ads and personalized recommendations.
* Leverage AI tools and AI\-driven insights for customer segmentation, personalization, campaign ideation, content creation, churn prediction, and campaign optimization.
* Use AI and automation to identify high\-value customers, churn\-prone users, purchase patterns, and next\-best\-action opportunities.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service, Product, Performance Marketing, and Creative teams to deliver a consistent customer experience.
* Monitor campaign metrics such as repeat purchase rate, retention rate, churn rate, CLV, CAC, conversion rate, ROAS, revenue per customer, and campaign ROI.
* Conduct A/B testing and continuously optimize messaging, offers, audience segments, timing, and channels based on performance data.
* Use Google Analytics/GA4, CRM/CDP, marketing automation, and analytics tools to track customer journeys and campaign performance.
* Stay updated on AI\-powered CRM, personalization, ecommerce retention, automation, and customer engagement trends and identify new growth opportunities.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in Retention/CRM/Lifecycle Marketing, preferably within an ecommerce or D2C environment.
* Hands\-on experience with customer segmentation, lifecycle marketing, CRM campaigns, retention strategies, and campaign optimization.
* Experience with email marketing, WhatsApp/SMS marketing, push notifications, loyalty programs, and retargeting campaigns.
* Strong understanding of RFM analysis, customer lifecycle, churn, CLV/LTV, repeat purchase behavior, and cohort analysis.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) and other customer/data analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Klaviyo, MoEngage, WebEngage, CleverTap, HubSpot, Braze, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or AI\-powered marketing/CRM platforms for campaign ideation, personalization, customer insights, content generation, and analysis.
* Ability to use AI and automation to improve campaign efficiency and customer personalization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to convert customer data into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create personalized and conversion\-focused marketing communication.
* Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Creative, strategic, data\-driven, and AI\-first mindset with a strong understanding of ecommerce customer behavior.

title: AI Advisory-Product Marketing
description:
HCLTech is a leading global IT services and software company, surpassing $14 billion in revenue this year. Leveraging our strong foundation and leadership in AI, Digital, Cloud and Engineering capabilities, we are poised to make significant strides in the AI and GenAI space.
 



 We’re seeking a Deputy Marketing Manager for our AI advisory portfolio. HCLTech’s AI Advisory services offer consulting across 1\) Idea\-to\-POC development through AI Labs 2\) Responsible AI \& Governance 3\) Business Process Reengineering, 4\) Cybersecurity and Red teaming, driving our mission to support clients in their AI Journey.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* **Product Marketing Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute the product marketing strategy for the AI Advisory services, refining the AI narrative, messaging, and market positioning through go\-to\-market and experiential campaigns that align with business objectives and enhance brand awareness.
* **Product Launch Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end product pre\-launch and launch planning, including strategy, timelines, messaging, and execution. Partner with cross\-functional teams to prioritize milestones and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
* **Positioning \& Messaging:** 
 Create clear, compelling positioning and messaging frameworks, GTM materials, enablement content, and conceptual/demo videos that demonstrate how AI Advisory drives value stream innovation for clients.
* **Integrated Marketing Campaigns:** 
 Plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across digital, events, email, and other channels to drive demand generation, accelerate pipeline, and increase product adoption.
* **Account\-Based Marketing (ABM):** 
 Develop and own the ABM strategy for strategic accounts and partners, leveraging 1:1 and 1:few programs to maximize engagement and influence.
* **Performance Measurement \& Analytics:** 
 Measure and report on marketing and GTM program performance, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and provide data\-driven insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* **Market \& Competitive Intelligence:** 
 Track AI industry trends, analyze analyst reports, and perform competitive analysis to inform GTM strategy, positioning, and product development.
* **Content \& Enablement Management:** 
 Develop and maintain product website content, sales enablement tools, and all GTM materials to support internal teams and customer\-facing initiatives.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 8\+ years of B2B marketing and product marketing experience in high\-growth SaaS or enterprise software companies.
* Proven track record of creating and executing successful product marketing strategies and go\-to\-market plans, including product launches.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer insights to drive strategy.
* Expertise in positioning, messaging and value proposition development.
* Experience in sales enablement, developing collateral, training and tools that support revenue growth.
* Ability to track and measure marketing success metrics, including impact on pipeline, revenue, and GTM ROI.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Effective at building cross\-functional relationships and influencing stakeholders, with excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Experience managing external agencies to produce high\-quality marketing materials and programs.
* Ability to excel in fast\-moving, dynamic environments while applying creative and innovative problem\-solving.
* Degree in Marketing, Business Administration; MBA preferred.



  





 You will be part of a close knit, highly passionate team that is working in one of the most talked about areas in the technology industry today.

title: Head of Sales and Marketing
description:
**Company:** 
 Contract Bazaar (Lex Mores Tech Pvt. Ltd.)
 



**Location:** 
 Greater Noida, Sector 4(on\-site)
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports to:** 
 Founder
 



  




 About Contract Bazaar
 
 Contract Bazaar is a legal\-tech platform that helps MSMEs and startups across India get their legal foundations right. We offer lawyer\-drafted contracts, compliance support and legal advice at fixed, transparent prices, so business owners can protect their business without open\-ended legal bills.
 


 Role summary
 
 We are looking for a Head of Sales and Marketing to own revenue and turn strong demand into a predictable, system\-driven growth engine. You will own the full funnel from first contact to signed deal, build new revenue channels, lead the sales team, and put in place the processes and tracking that make sales and marketing run on systems rather than on individuals.
 



  




 Key responsibilitiesRevenue and targets
 
 •     Set monthly and quarterly revenue targets for each sales channel, and back\-calculate each into the leads, consultations, conversions and daily activity it needs.
 



 •     Own the revenue number and deliver against it, with a weekly forecast and gap analysis.
 



 •     Build and maintain the revenue model, updating planning assumptions with actual conversion rates.
 



  




 Sales funnel management
 
 •     Own the full funnel, from first contact to signed deal and handover to the delivery team.
 



 •     Make sure every lead has a status, an owner and a next action with a date at all times.
 



 •     Set and enforce speed\-to\-lead standards.
 



 •     Reduce drop\-offs at every stage, including unbooked leads, no\-shows and consultations that didn't convert.
 



 •     Oversee closing, follow\-ups, payment collection and handover to delivery.
 



  




 Channel development
 
 •     Run event\-led sales end to end: pre\-event planning, on\-ground lead capture, post\-event follow\-up and conversion.
 



 •     Build new revenue channels, including existing\-client cross\-sell and retainers, referral partnerships with CAs, CSs and consultants, platform and corporate partnerships, search, webinars and masterclasses, and industry associations.
 



 •     Reduce dependence on any single channel by building a balanced revenue mix.
 



  




 Team leadership
 
 •     Lead the sales team, including callers, legal consultants and client coordinators, with clear role definitions and individual targets.
 



 •     Run daily stand\-ups, weekly performance reviews and monthly target resets.
 



 •     Audit sales calls regularly and coach the team on needs discovery, objection handling and closing.
 



 •     Hire, onboard and train new team members as the function grows.
 


 Marketing
 
 •     Own lead generation and nurture across all channels.
 



 •     Plan and run WhatsApp and email nurture flows for each lead segment.
 



 •     Own the content calendar across LinkedIn, Instagram and WhatsApp, working with the founder on thought\-leadership content.
 



 •     Plan and run monthly webinars or masterclasses for both nurture and acquisition.
 



 •     Oversee website conversion, landing pages and paid campaigns.
 



 •     Ensure all marketing and advertising complies with Bar Council of India rules.
 


 Systems, tracking and reporting
 
 •     Maintain the CRM or lead tracker so the data is accurate and up to date.
 



 •     Set up source tracking and attribution for every lead, campaign and channel.
 



 •     Track campaign performance and act on underperforming campaigns.
 



 •     Deliver weekly funnel reports and monthly channel\-wise revenue reviews to the founders.
 


 Process and SOPs
 
 •     Document and maintain SOPs for every stage of sales and marketing.
 



 •     Continuously improve processes based on data, loss reasons and team feedback.
 



 •     Coordinate with delivery, finance and partner teams for smooth handovers and a consistent client experience.

title: Social Media and Operations Intern
description:
**Company Description** 
 DKD Capital is an independent equity research platform focused on identifying emerging businesses at pivotal stages in their growth journey. The firm applies a structured four\-step framework—Discover, Analyse, Time, and Compound—to build and maintain robust, evidence\-based research theses. Its approach combines Growth at a Reasonable Price (GARP) with disciplined technical validation, emphasizing fundamentals, valuation, and price–volume behavior. DKD Capital’s research centers on small and microcap businesses, stage 2 growth opportunities, and continuous coverage through earnings updates and sector insights. The platform is led by SEBI Registered Research Analyst Divya Khurana Dewan, with a strong focus on analytical rigor, transparency, and responsible investor communication in line with applicable regulations.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'll own our social media presence and support day\-to\-day operations. That means building our LinkedIn page from scratch, planning what we publish across platforms, and helping us respond to the people who reach out. Your work will be visible publicly from week one.
 



**Responsibilities — social media and content** 



* Build and grow our LinkedIn company page from the ground up: positioning, page setup, content calendar and audience growth
* Develop a content strategy across Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook, deciding what format belongs where and why
* Plan and coordinate reels: ideation, scripting support, shoot coordination, editing or working with an editor, captions and hashtags
* Design carousels and static posts in our brand style
* Plan the blog and insights calendar for our website, and coordinate with our research interns on topics
* Schedule posts, track performance, and report weekly on what's working
* Research what's performing well in the Indian finance content space and bring ideas to the table



**Responsibilities — operations and client support** 



* Respond to enquiries on Instagram, email and WhatsApp using approved templates, and escalate anything that needs the founder
* Maintain our lead tracker: who enquired, what they asked, what stage they're at
* Coordinate discovery calls and webinars, including scheduling, reminders and follow\-ups
* Support client onboarding: documentation, KYC coordination and payment follow\-ups
* Keep our content, lead and client records organised



**What you'll learn** 



* How a SEBI\-registered equity research firm is built and run
* Content marketing in a regulated industry, which is a genuinely rare skill
* How equity research works, from filings to published reports
* Working directly with the founder on strategy, not just execution



**Requirements** 



* Strong written English, with a clear, simple style
* A real understanding of how Instagram and LinkedIn work, including what makes content perform on each
* Comfortable with Canva or similar design tools
* Organised and reliable, since you'll be handling client\-facing communication
* Willing to learn financial concepts, even if you don't know them yet



**Good to have** 



* Video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Rush or similar)
* Interest in or basic knowledge of the stock market
* Experience running a page, personal or professional
* Familiarity with SEO basics



**An important note about this industry** 




 We operate under SEBI's Research Analyst Regulations. Everything we publish follows strict rules: no promises of returns, no client testimonials, no stock tips, and no personalised advice. You'll never be asked to write anything that overstates what we do, and all content goes through the founder for approval before publishing. If you want to learn how to build an audience honestly in a regulated field, this is a good place to do it.
 



**Details** 



* Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (in\-office)
* Timings: 9:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Duration: 3 months, with the possibility of a full\-time role
* Stipend: ₹10,000 per month
* Certificate and letter of recommendation on successful completion



**How to apply** 




 Email info@divyakhurana.com with your CV.

* Lead go\-to\-market (GTM) planning and execution for new product launches, feature releases, and product enhancements.
* Create customer\-focused messaging frameworks that effectively communicate product benefits and business outcomes.



  





**Demand Generation \& Digital Marketing** 



* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, email, webinars, events, content marketing, and partner channels.
* Drive demand generation initiatives to support pipeline growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.
* Collaborate with performance marketing teams to optimize campaigns across paid, organic, and owned channels.
* Manage product\-focused digital campaigns, landing pages, lead nurturing workflows, and conversion optimization initiatives.



  





**Social Media \& Brand Visibility** 



* Own product\-related social media strategy and content planning across platforms such as LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, and industry communities.
* Develop engaging product storytelling content including blogs, videos, customer success stories, case studies, webinars, and thought leadership assets.
* Build and manage online communities to strengthen customer engagement and product advocacy.
* Collaborate with influencers, industry experts, and partners to enhance product awareness and credibility.



  





**Market Research \& Competitive Intelligence** 



* Conduct market research, customer interviews, competitor analysis, and industry trend assessments.
* Gather customer insights to influence product positioning, messaging, and roadmap discussions.
* Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and customer behavior to identify growth opportunities.



  





**Sales Enablement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to align marketing efforts with business objectives.
* Develop sales enablement materials including presentations, product collateral, battle cards, FAQs, demo scripts, and customer\-facing assets.
* Support customer acquisition and retention initiatives through targeted marketing programs and customer lifecycle campaigns.



  





**AI\-Powered Marketing \& Analytics** 



* Leverage AI\-powered marketing tools for content creation, audience segmentation, campaign optimization, marketing automation, and customer insights.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI technologies into marketing workflows to improve efficiency, personalization, and campaign effectiveness.
* Track and analyze campaign performance, product adoption metrics, lead generation KPIs, and customer engagement data.
* Generate actionable insights and recommend optimization strategies based on performance analysis.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* **4\+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, Digital Marketing, or related roles within SaaS companies.**
* Experience working with
 **B2B and/or D2C SaaS products** 
 and understanding of subscription\-based business models.
* Proven experience in product launches, go\-to\-market strategy, customer engagement, and demand generation.
* Strong understanding of product positioning, messaging, competitive analysis, and customer journey mapping.

**Company Description** 
 DappLogix Software Pvt Ltd is a technology\-focused company dedicated to building software solutions that help organizations scale and optimize their digital products. The team works across the product lifecycle, from ideation and development to delivery and performance improvement. DappLogix emphasizes collaboration, data\-driven decision\-making, and modern engineering practices to create reliable and efficient applications. The company offers a professional environment where team members can contribute to product growth while expanding their own skills and expertise.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Product Growth \& Expansion Manager is a full\-time role responsible for driving user growth, market expansion, and revenue optimization for DappLogix products. This hybrid position is based in Noida, with a mix of on\-site collaboration and some work\-from\-home flexibility. Day\-to\-day tasks include analyzing product performance and user behavior, identifying growth opportunities, and designing experiments or initiatives to improve acquisition, engagement, and retention. The role involves conducting market research, monitoring competitors, and collaborating closely with product, sales, marketing, and engineering teams to define and execute growth strategies. description:
**Digital Content Specialist** 




  





 Reports to: Head, Communications
 



 Location:On\-site, TDV Delhi (with close coordination across Nantes and Italy campuses)
 



  





**Role** 




  





 The Digital Content Specialist owns how TDV shows up online — across social, search, and web — turning the story of a design\-led institution into content that captivates prospective students, parents, and the broader design community. This is a hands\-on role combining creative storytelling with the discipline of SEO and performance tracking, working closely with admissions, academic, and design teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and on\-brand.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Content \& Storytelling** 




 \- Write compelling, audience\-focused copy for web, email, blog, and ad campaigns
 



 \- Regularly edit and update website content for accuracy, clarity, and brand\-tone alignment
 



 \- Translate academic and admissions milestones into stories that resonate with prospective students and parents
 



  





**Social \& Community** 




 \- Manage and grow TDV's social media presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, and emerging platforms
 



 \- Build and maintain a content calendar aligned with admissions cycles, events, and campaigns
 



 \- Monitor and respond to community engagement, maintaining TDV's voice and responsiveness online
 



  





**SEO \& Organic Growth** 




 \- Own and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy to grow visibility and organic traffic
 



 \- Conduct keyword research and on\-page optimization across web and blog content
 



 \- Stay current on search algorithm changes and adjust strategy accordingly
 



  





**Monitoring Paid Marketing Performance** 




 \- Track paid campaign performance across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads, alongside the Digital/Performance Marketing function
 



 \- Monitor key metrics (CPL, CTR, conversion rate, spend efficiency) to spot underperformance or creative fatigue early
 



 \- Ensure paid and organic messaging stay consistent — same narrative and tone across every paid and owned channel
 



 \- Feed paid\-campaign learnings back into organic content strategy, and vice versa
 



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration** 




 \- Partner with design, admissions, and academic teams to ensure content supports enrollment and outreach goals
 



 \- Coordinate with the Digital/Performance Marketing function on paid\-organic content alignment
 



 \- Support Nantes and Italy campus teams with localized content needs as TDV's European footprint grows
 



  





**Analytics \& Optimization** 




 \- Track performance across channels using Google Analytics and platform\-native insights
 



 \- Translate data into actionable recommendations — what to double down on, what to retire
 



 \- Report content, SEO, and paid\-performance summaries on a regular cadence to the Head, Communications 
 



  





**Profile** 




 \- 3\+ years of experience in digital content, marketing, or communications — ideally in education, design, or a creative\-industry\-adjacent space
 



 \- Strong command of SEO principles and digital publishing best practices
 



 \- Working knowledge of paid platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager) — hands\-on execution not required, but comfortable reading and interpreting performance data
 



 \- Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with an eye for visual\-first platforms
 



 \- Experience with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), social media management tools, and basic HTML
 



 \- Comfortable with Google Analytics, keyword tools, and content performance metrics
 



  





**Traits** 




 \- Creative instincts paired with analytical discipline
 



 \- Self\-starter who can manage a content calendar independently
 



 \- Collaborative — comfortable working across design, admissions, marketing, and academic stakeholders
 



 \- Genuine interest in design, education, and digital culture
 



 \- Adaptable to a fast\-moving, growing institution with multiple campuses

title: Vice President of Growth
description:
Neocambrian AI is building the data infrastructure for physical AI. We design and operate capture systems that turn real\-world human activity into model\-usable physical experience for leading robotics companies and frontier AI labs.
 



  





 Our ability to scale depends on access to the physical world.
 



  





 We are hiring a
 **Network Growth Lead** 
 to build the industrial network through which our hardware and operators enter factories, warehouses, workshops, and other real\-world environments across India.
 



 You will create access, convert relationships into live collection operations, and help establish Neocambrian as a visible and trusted company across industrial India.
 



  





 You may spend one morning making the commercial case to a factory owner and the afternoon working with a plant supervisor and our operations team to resolve the practical details required to launch collection on the floor.
 



  





 You will own the relationship from the first introduction to signed access, site readiness, launch, and a partnership that expands over time.
 



  




 What you will own
 * **Factory access across India:** 
 Build and manage a qualified network of manufacturing and industrial partners, with density in the clusters, industries, and task environments that matter most.
* **Partnership conversion:** 
 Own the complete journey from first contact and commercial agreement through site assessment, operational readiness, launch, and handoff into productive collection.
* **Cluster expansion:** 
 Map the industrial landscape, identify the right associations and connectors, and determine where Neocambrian should build depth rather than scatter its efforts.
* **Operational scale:** 
 Work closely with the operations team to ensure that factory access turns into reliable, repeatable data collection—not partnerships that exist only on paper.
* **A repeatable growth system:** 
 Build partner playbooks, onboarding standards, objection\-handling processes, reference loops, pipeline discipline, and reporting systems that make every new site easier to open than the last.
* **Visibility and reputation:** 
 Build Neocambrian’s presence across industrial associations, owner networks, ecosystem partners, events, and relevant public channels. Help turn our work in the field into credible stories, case studies, and partnerships that attract the next opportunity.
* **Market intelligence:** 
 Develop a clear understanding of what manufacturers care about, what prevents them from granting access, and what Neocambrian can offer that makes a long\-term partnership valuable to them.



  




 Who you are
 * You have approximately
 **5–7 years of experience** 
 building supply\-side networks, partner channels, industrial business development, distributed operations, or B2B relationships where physical access and trust matter.
* You have spent meaningful time in factories, warehouses, workshops, logistics networks, or other industrial environments. You understand that access in this world is rarely won through a cold email alone.
* You can build trust with a factory owner, communicate effectively with a plant director, and work practically with a supervisor or operator on the floor.
* You are commercially sharp but operationally grounded. You do not consider the job complete when an agreement is signed; you stay close until the site is live and productive.
* You can manage a large number of relationships and moving parts without losing attention to detail.
* You are comfortable with frequent travel across India and prefer being in the field to managing the entire function from a desk.
* You think like a dealmaker, operate like a programme owner, and want your work measured in sites opened, production enabled, and reputation compounded.



  




 What helps
 
 Experience in manufacturing, industrial services, logistics infrastructure, supply networks, B2B partnerships, field operations, or marketplace supply will be particularly valuable.
 



 Existing relationships with factory owners, industrial associations, cluster bodies, or manufacturing ecosystem partners are a strong advantage, but not a requirement.
 



  




 Location and working model
 
**Location:** 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time and on\-site
 



**Travel:** 
 Frequent travel across India
 



**Start date:** 
 Immediate
 



  





 Apply through LinkedIn or send a short note and CV to
 **careers@neocambrian.ai** 
 .
 



 In your note, tell us about a physical network you have built, and how you turned relationships into repeatable operations.

title: Account Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Missions And Responsibilities Of The Role**
**Strategy:** 
 Person in this position will play a pivotal role in Thales growth trajectory in India . The person will be responsible for providing inputs and project managing the building of the growth strategies for the India region, closely working with key internal stakeholders and external partners.
   

  

**Marketing:** 
 Person in this position will collaborate with business leaders to understand and analyze the market, to ensure that Thales’ products \& services correspond to customer needs and expectations. The person in this role will also implement elements of the Corporate Marketing Plan for the Region.
   

  

**Outcomes: Strategy / Business Development:**
* Actively supports the annual rolling 5\-year regional/country strategic plans for alignment with GBUs, MoD strategic account plans, and country strategic plan, with clear understanding of the economic and industrial trends of the market (including customer needs and competitor offerings), Thales addressable market, and strategy to win keeping in mind Make in India obligations \- in order to secure Thales’ position and growth in the market.
* Execute continuous monitoring of the global trends, competitor activities, regulatory changes and emerging technologies. Address key questions to inform the Group on how India can play a role as a market, a supplier and an innovation engine
* Identify growth opportunities, organic and inorganic, and prepare report/ recommendations for management review/ action.
* Lead/Co\-lead critical special projects as needed in partnership with internal stakeholders. This would also include contributing to must\-win sales / pre\-sales engagements, including capture plans / GTM strategy, partner selection, competitive offense / defense strategies.
* Key responsibility to identify and nurture white spaces, to the point where it can be handed over to sales, in line with Group’s Gate review processes


**Outcomes: Marketing:**
* Generates a Marketing Plan aligned with the Country Strategic Plan (CSP) and coordinate corresponding actions
* Supports Key Account Managers/ Sales \& Business development teams in promoting Thales’ solutions during the upstream opportunity phase
* Understands/ analyses the customer’s mission, operational environment and priorities.
* Drives marketing efforts and defines the best solution (product/system/service) addressing customers’ needs during the upstream opportunity phase
* Analyze the accessible and non\-accessible market, customer needs and developments, budgeted investment programme, competition (strategy, products), and contribute to medium\-term order intake forecasts with the sales forces
* Deploys adapted tools to support strategic business intelligence and keep abreast of trends and competitor’s marketing movements.


**Candidate Qualifications/Requirements for the role:**
* Engineer OR MBA from premier business school.
* At least 8\+ years of experience in relevant industry preferably from Aerospace \& Defense and / or in management consulting .
* Experience working in a multi\-national organization. Ability to navigate a highly matrixed organization.
* International exposure (education, work experience) preferred.
* Adaptability in a fast\-evolving technological and geo\-political landscape.
* Excellent influencing and relationship\-building skills
* Results\-oriented, team player, excellent written and verbal communication skills, good attention to detail, strong project management skills and ability to work under pressure.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Manager, Marketing Operations
description:
Daxko builds the software that powers fitness, wellness, and community organizations—everything from member management and payments to digital engagement and analytics. From small studios to the largest associations, we help thousands of fitness businesses streamline operations, enhance member experiences, and drive sustainable revenue growth.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of how Daxko's go\-to\-market engine runs. As
 **Senior Manager, Marketing Operations** 
 , you own the quality, completeness, and activation\-readiness of our customer and prospect data — the foundation everything else is built on. You'll design the architecture, lead a team of specialists, and make sure the data flowing into our campaigns, segments, and ABM programs is accurate, enriched, and ready to act on.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own data enrichment end\-to\-end: tool selection, provider management, AI\-assisted workflows, and the roadmap for maintaining best\-in\-class data completeness across the database
* Engineer multi\-source enrichment pipelines through Snowflake and Databricks into CDP activation layers, translating pipeline goals into clear data requirements and audience intelligence at scale
* Design and enforce governance standards across field ownership, enrichment source hierarchy, freshness SLAs, and tagging conventions; maintain data dictionaries that serve as the team's source of truth
* Own identity resolution logic, including merge rules, deduplication standards, and record governance, and define the field\-level segmentation and trigger criteria that make HubSpot and CDP data immediately activation\-ready
* Lead structured experimentation across enrichment sources, segmentation logic, and trigger criteria to improve downstream conversion; evaluate and sunset tools that no longer serve the stack
* Partner with demand gen, martech, and ops stakeholders to align data strategy with pipeline goals, ensuring the stack operates as a connected, high\-performing system
* Lead and develop a team of individual contributors: set clear goals, run regular 1:1s, support growth, and hold a high execution standard on QA, documentation, and data accuracy


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years in marketing operations in a B2B SaaS environment
* Expert\-level HubSpot experience with direct ownership of database quality, enrichment programs, and MAP data architecture
* Deep, hands\-on experience with B2B enrichment platforms and data providers, including multi\-source layering and field\-level enrichment decisions
* Proven ability to design segmentation and trigger logic from the ground up, translating ICP and campaign criteria into scalable rules in HubSpot
* Experience building AI\-assisted enrichment workflows, with sound judgment on output quality, failure modes, and when human review is required
* Working knowledge of how data moves through a B2B MarTech stack, from enrichment provider into CRM through to campaign activation
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or equivalent relevant experience


**Nice to have**
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and enrichment logic review
* Experience with CDP concepts and how enriched data connects to triggered campaign infrastructure
* Familiarity with ABM platforms, intent data tools, or AI\-powered marketing automation
* HubSpot, Salesforce, or Google Analytics certifications


 Daxko is dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. We are committed to diversity in the broadest sense, including thought and perspective, age, ability, nationality, ethnicity, orientation, and gender. The skills, perspectives, ideas, and experiences of all of our team members contribute to the vitality and success of our purpose and values.
   

  

 We truly care for our team members, and this is reflected through our offices, and benefits, and great perks. These perks are only for our full\-time team members.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist (D2C)
description:
**About us:** 




 Seventh Triangle is a Shopify Premier Partner martech and commerce agency led by former D2C founders. We run performance, retention, SEO/AEO, CRO and Shopify development for 40\+ D2C brands across India, the UK, US and Middle East. We work in short sprints, decide on data, and are accountable to clients for revenue, not impressions.
 



  





**The role:** 




 You will own paid media and retention for 4 to 5 Indian D2C brands, with monthly budgets from ₹5L to ₹50L per account. This is not a media\-buying seat. We expect you to understand unit economics, know why a brand's repeat rate matters and not just ROAS, and have a view on what the ad should say before the designer comes up with the first draft. You report to a Senior Marketing Manager and join client calls from week three.
 



  





**What you will do:** 



* Plan, run and scale Meta (Advantage\+, catalogue, creative testing) and Google (PMax, Shopping, Search) campaigns against CAC, contribution margin.
* Own the retention layer for your accounts: Email and WhatsApp flows, segmentation, and lifecycle campaigns on Klaviyo, Zepic or similar.
* Write creative briefs from customer and competitor insight, and work with our design, video and UGC team to ship and test them weekly.
* Contribute to brand positioning and messaging for your accounts, not just the ad copy
* Read GA4, Shopify analytics and ad platform data to find what is actually driving revenue, and change the plan accordingly
* Present weekly and monthly performance to clients, present the numbers, and recommend next moves.
* Coordinate with our Tech, CRO, Design and SEO teams so campaigns land on pages that convert.



  





**What good looks like at 90 days:** 




 You are running your accounts without hand\-holding, clients trust your numbers, at least one retention flow you built is producing measurable repeat revenue, and creative you briefed is beating the brand's previous best.
 



  





**What this role is not:** 



* A reporting role where someone else decides the strategy
* A pure CRM or lifecycle role with no paid media
* Lead generation, B2B or SaaS marketing



  





**You should have:** 



* 3\+ years running Meta and Google Ads for D2C or ecommerce brands, ideally in an agency handling multiple accounts
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and at least one retention tool (Klaviyo, Zepic, WebEngage, MoEngage, Interakt or WATI)
* Working knowledge of D2C economics: CAC, LTV, contribution margin, repeat rate
* A track record of briefing creative, not just running what you were given
* Comfort presenting to founders and marketing heads
* GA4 and spreadsheet fluency; attribution tool experience is a plus



  





**Why here:** 




 You learn D2C from people who have built and sold D2C. You see 4 to 5 categories at once instead of one brand for three years. Your work is measured in client revenue, and so is your growth here.

**Head of Marketing (GTM \& Demand Generation)**

**The Brief** 




 You will own and lead the entire marketing organization at Damco, with a primary mandate to build a world\-class
 **go\-to\-market (GTM) and demand generation engine** 
 that drives measurable pipeline, revenue growth, market expansion, and category leadership.
 



 This is not a traditional brand marketing role. You will be expected to operate as the commercial counterpart to Sales, owning the strategy and execution that turns market positioning into qualified demand and revenue.
 



 You will lead marketing across
 **GTM strategy, demand generation, account\-based marketing (ABM), digital marketing, content, category marketing, field marketing, events, partner marketing, brand, design, inbound, outbound, and marketing operations.** 
 All marketing team leads report into you.
 



 You will be responsible for repositioning Damco from an IT services company to a recognized
 **AI Transformation Partner** 
 while simultaneously building a predictable, scalable pipeline generation engine across North America.
 



 Most IT services companies compete with the same messaging, the same channels, and the same claims. We are looking for someone who understands how markets are won through differentiated positioning, focused GTM execution, and relentless demand creation. You should have a strong point of view on how marketing creates competitive advantage, drives revenue, and influences enterprise buying decisions.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and revenue growth. You must understand AI, cloud, data, modernization, and enterprise technology well enough to translate complex capabilities into compelling market narratives that generate engagement, opportunities, and pipeline.
 



**What You'll Own** 



1. **Revenue Marketing \& Pipeline Growth**


* End\-to\-end ownership of marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced pipeline, opportunity creation, and contribution to revenue targets.


1. **Go\-to\-Market Strategy**


* Market segmentation, ICP definition, account prioritization, buyer journeys, messaging architecture, competitive positioning, and launch strategies.


1. **Demand Generation Engine**


* Multi\-channel demand programs across ABM, paid media, digital, content, events, partner ecosystems, SDR alignment, and outbound campaigns.


1. **Brand \& Category Leadership**


* Positioning, narrative development, thought leadership, analyst relations, market perception, and category creation around AI transformation.


1. **Marketing Operations \& Performance**


* Attribution, funnel conversion, campaign performance, marketing technology stack, reporting cadence, forecasting, and ROI measurement.


1. **Channel Strategy**


* Determining where Damco will invest, scale, and differentiate across field marketing, events, partnerships, digital channels, communities, content, and executive engagement programs.


1. **Marketing Organization**


* Team structure, hiring, capability development, budgeting, agency management, and performance management of all marketing leaders.



**What Success Looks Like** 



1. Damco is recognized in the market as an AI Transformation Partner rather than a traditional IT services provider.
2. Marketing becomes a predictable source of qualified pipeline, consistently generating opportunities that convert into revenue.
3. Target buyers including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Heads of Data, Engineering Leaders, and Digital Transformation Executives know Damco before entering a sales cycle.
4. Enterprise account penetration improves through highly targeted ABM and strategic GTM programs.
5. Marketing and Sales operate as a unified revenue organization with clearly defined funnel ownership, performance metrics, and accountability.
6. Pipeline, opportunity creation, conversion rates, CAC, marketing ROI, win rates, and revenue influence are visible, measurable, and improving quarter over quarter.
7. A high\-performance marketing organization consistently launches impactful campaigns, moves quickly, and attracts top talent.



**What You'll Do** 



1. Develop and execute a growth\-oriented marketing strategy aligned with company revenue objectives.
2. Build and optimize an account\-based go\-to\-market model targeting enterprise buyers across priority industries and accounts.
3. Drive marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced pipeline through integrated demand generation programs.
4. Partner closely with Sales leadership to align territory strategy, account planning, campaign execution, and opportunity acceleration.
5. Establish a data\-driven marketing operating model with clear ownership of funnel metrics, attribution, conversion optimization, and forecasting.
6. Build scalable programs across paid media, digital marketing, content syndication, webinars, executive events, industry conferences, partner ecosystems, and outbound campaigns.
7. Develop industry\-specific GTM strategies and value propositions that resonate with enterprise decision\-makers.
8. Lead product, solution, and service launches with clear positioning, messaging, and demand generation plans.
9. Work closely with AI, engineering, delivery, and customer teams to ensure technical credibility across all market\-facing communications.
10. Develop the next generation of Damco's thought leadership and executive visibility programs, establishing the company as a trusted voice in AI transformation.
11. Balance long\-term brand equity investments with short\-term pipeline objectives while maintaining accountability for both.
12. Report performance transparently and continuously optimize investment decisions based on measurable business outcomes.



**What You Bring** 



1. **15\+ years of B2B marketing leadership experience** 
 , including significant responsibility for demand generation, GTM strategy, pipeline creation, and revenue growth within technology, SaaS, IT services, consulting, or adjacent enterprise markets.
2. Proven experience owning multi\-million\-dollar pipeline targets and demonstrating measurable impact on bookings and revenue.
3. Deep expertise in enterprise GTM strategy, including ICP development, account segmentation, ABM, buyer journey mapping, and sales alignment.
4. Strong understanding of AI, cloud, data, modernization, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling market narratives.
5. A demonstrable track record of scaling demand generation programs that drive opportunity creation, pipeline acceleration, and revenue growth.
6. Expertise in marketing analytics, attribution, funnel optimization, conversion metrics, forecasting, and performance management.
7. Experience managing integrated marketing channels, including ABM, digital advertising, LinkedIn, content marketing, SEO, field marketing, executive events, partner marketing, outbound programs, and strategic alliances.
8. Strong brand leadership credentials, including positioning, messaging architecture, thought leadership, and category development.
9. Exceptional leadership capability with experience building, coaching, restructuring, and scaling high\-performing marketing teams.
10. A commercial mindset that views marketing as a revenue\-generating function, not a support function.



**Bonus** 



* Experience leading GTM and demand generation for IT services, AI consulting, digital engineering, cloud services, or enterprise software organizations.
* Experience owning annual pipeline targets exceeding $50M\+ and building repeatable revenue marketing systems.
* Success scaling ABM programs targeting Fortune 1000 or large enterprise accounts.
* Experience partnering directly with CROs and sales organizations to achieve revenue goals.
* Experience building analyst, influencer, executive community, or ecosystem\-led growth programs.
* A recognized market presence through speaking engagements, publications, podcasts, research, or thought leadership on AI, digital transformation, or enterprise technology.



 Key Enhancement
 



 This version shifts the role from being primarily
 **brand\-led marketing**

 **revenue\-first Chief Growth Marketing profile** 
 , emphasizing:
 


* GTM ownership

With an enterprise footprint of approximately 3,000 employees, the company commands a strong international presence spanning 70\+ countries across India, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and North America.

Entering its next phase of global growth, the organization is focused on scaling its international footprint by strengthening product leadership, driving AI\-led differentiation, and deepening vertical specialization, particularly within intelligent lending solutions for banks and NBFCs.
 



 To learn more about our culture, updates, and global footprint, visit our Company Website and follow our official LinkedIn Page.

title: Social Media & Content Strategist Intern
description:
**About Tripzy:** 




 Tripzy is India's one\-stop platform for discovering, planning, and booking personalized travel experiences built for anyone, anywhere in India, with Gen Z and millennial travelers as our core audience. Using AI, we generate recommendations tailored to who you are and what you actually want out of a trip: where to stay, how to get around, and what to do, in destinations across India that most travel platforms ignore.We're a startup, not a big company pretending to be small the work is real, the pace is fast, and what you do here has visible impact almost immediately.
 



  





**What You'll Do:**



* This role owns how Tripzy shows up online not just posting, but actually building an audience.Plan, create, and post content across Instagram and other platforms; reels, stories, posts that gets young Indian travelers to actually stop scrolling
* Come up with original content ideas and formats, not just repurpose what's trending elsewhere we want content that feels like Tripzy, not generic travel\-page content
* Track what's working and what isn't engagement, follower growth, reach and adjust based on real numbers, not guesses
* Engage directly with our community replying to comments and DMs, building relationships with followers, not just broadcasting at them
* Collaborate with the founder and the rest of the team on campaigns, launches, and brand voice
* Bring your own opinions on what Tripzy's content should look like we want your judgment, not just execution of a content calendar some AI CHATBOT wrote.



  





 Stipend: Based on Performance(2\.5\-5K per month)
 



  





 We hire on 9 values: Judgment, Communication, Impact, Curiosity, Innovation, Courage, Passion, Honesty, and Selflessness.
 



**Who We're Not Looking For:**




 We'd rather tell you upfront who this role isn't for, so you can decide for yourself if you belong here:
 



 We're not looking for people who don't align with these 9 values this isn't a checklist we glance at, it's how we actually want to work
 


* We're not looking for people who are here just for an internship certificate, or applying casually to pad a resume we want people who genuinely want to grow with this startup
* We're not looking for yes\-men if you agree with everything I say, something's wrong. We want people who'll push back when they think I'm wrong
* We're not looking for people who put their own convenience or credit above the company's interest
* We're not looking for people who get defensive or shut down when they receive feedback if you can't take candor, you won't be able to give it either
* If none of that describes you, and you're excited to build something real with us, we want to hear from you.Beyond that: currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Media, or a related field, and a genuine eye for what makes content work you understand pacing, hooks, and what actually stops someone from scrolling past. A portfolio or personal content you've made (even for yourself) is a strong plus.

title: Influencer Marketing Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Influxia Media is a leading influencer marketing agency in India that specializes in connecting brands with the right creators to build authentic, impactful campaigns. The agency helps brands amplify their messaging through strategic partnerships with influencers across multiple platforms. Influxia Media also supports influencers by creating opportunities to collaborate with established and emerging brands. Applicants can expect to work in a fast\-paced, creative environment focused on data\-driven marketing and meaningful brand–influencer relationships.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Marketing Intern role at Influxia Media is an on\-site position based in Noida. The intern will support the marketing team with daily activities such as conducting market research, assisting in campaign planning, and helping identify suitable influencers for client projects. Responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams, preparing basic performance reports, updating databases, and supporting outreach efforts to brands and influencers. The intern will also assist with social media activities, content ideas, and basic customer communication. This is an internship role designed to provide hands\-on experience in influencer and digital marketing.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with internal teams, brands, and influencers.
* Candidates should possess Market Research and Marketing Strategy skills to support campaign planning and analysis.
* Candidates should possess foundational Sales and Marketing skills to assist with outreach and partnership development.
* Candidates should have proficiency with common digital tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software, social media platforms).
* Candidates should demonstrate strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
* Candidates should be pursuing or have recently completed a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
* Candidates with an interest in influencer marketing, social media trends, and digital advertising will be preferred.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Collabzi is a next\-generation creator monetization platform designed to help social media creators earn consistently and transparently without depending on unpredictable brand sponsorships, manual negotiations, or sales\-based commission models.
 



 The creator economy has evolved rapidly, but monetization methods have not. Many creators still rely on one\-off deals, delayed payments, and opaque performance metrics. Collabzi was built to change that reality by introducing a performance\-driven, data\-backed monetization system that rewards creators for real engagement rather than vanity metrics.
 



 By combining artificial intelligence, click\-based attribution, and creator\-first design, Collabzi enables creators to transform everyday content into a reliable income stream while maintaining complete creative freedom and authenticity.
 



  





**Role Description:**




  





 This is a full\-time on\-site role for an Influencer Marketing Manager / Campaign Manager to independently manage influencer campaigns from planning to execution while ensuring exceptional client servicing and campaign delivery.
 



 The ideal candidate should be confident in managing client relationships, leading creator negotiations, coordinating with internal teams, and driving campaigns with minimal supervision.
 



  





**Qualifications:**




  




* 1\-5 years of experience in influencer marketing, branded content, or digital marketing (agency\-side preferred).
* Strong understanding of the influencer ecosystem across platforms (Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat, X, Sharechat, Moj, etc.).
* Demonstrated success in managing influencer campaigns from strategy to execution.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to track, interpret, and present campaign performance data.
* Passion for digital culture, creators, and social\-first storytelling.
* Ability to handle multiple accounts/projects simultaneously and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, influencer shoots, and industry events when required



  





**Who We Are Looking For:**




  




1. **Influencer Partnerships:** 
 Identify and establish relationships with influencers, content creators, and micro\-influencers aligned with client brands and campaigns.
2. **Campaign Strategy:** 
 Collaborate with clients and internal teams to develop influencer marketing strategies that align with brand objectives and messaging.
3. **Influencer Selection:** 
 Research, vet, and select suitable influencers based on audience demographics, engagement, and brand fit.
4. **Campaign Management:** 
 Coordinate and manage end\-to\-end influencer campaigns, including contract negotiation, content collaboration, and campaign execution.
5. **Performance Tracking:** 
 Monitor and analyse influencer campaign performance, providing insights and recommendations for optimisation.
6. **Budget Management:** 
 Manage influencer marketing budgets effectively, ensuring cost efficiency and campaign success.



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




* Independently manage influencer marketing campaigns from planning to completion.
* Lead campaign strategy and ensure smooth execution across multiple brands.
* Handle client communication and build strong client relationships.
* Lead creator sourcing, negotiations, onboarding, and closures.
* Ensure campaign quality, timely execution, and successful delivery.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless campaign execution.
* Mentor and guide junior team members whenever required.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and internal processes.
* Contribute to client retention and overall business growth.



  





**What You Will Get:**




  




* Competitive salary with performance incentives
* Opportunity to work with leading brands and marketing teams
* A professional, growth\-driven environment
* Fast career progression for strong performers



  





 If you bring strong experience in Influencer Marketing along with a passion for marketing and business development, we invite you to explore this opportunity and become a part of our growing team.
